name: PromptInput
description: The box people type a message in. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line, the box grows with the text, and the Send button becomes Stop while a reply is on its way.

onSubmit.description: Called with the trimmed text when the person sends.

onStop.description: Called when the person presses Stop.

isStreaming.description: A reply is on its way: the button becomes Stop and sending is blocked.

placeholder.description: Hint shown while the box is empty.

label.description: Accessible name of the text box.

value.description: Controlled text. Leave out to let the box keep its own.

keyboard: Tab: moves to the Send or Stop button
requirements: A real labelled multi-line text box; the shortcut hint is attached with aria-describedby
Enter does nothing while an input method (IME) is composing, so a half-typed word can't be sent
Send is disabled for empty or whitespace-only text; Stop replaces it while streaming and has its own name
Focus stays in the box after sending
Growth stops at a maximum height, then the box scrolls
screenReader: "Message, edit text, multi-line. Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line"

use_when: Any place a person writes to an assistant
avoid_when: A short single-line field: use TextField
anti_patterns: Sending on Enter without checking for IME composition
Clearing the box before the message is sent
